entities.summary: The National Police of Timor-Leste is the national police force of Timor-Leste. It is a security force armed and uniformed under administrative control of Minister of the Interior. The PNTL's policing philosophy is a community police force. However, in terms of organisation, training, discipline and personel status is identical to military. Nevertheles, the PNTL does not constitute a military force in the country. As the unique military force is the only Timor Leste Defence Force or F - FDTL. The PNTL applies tough line and Command Hierarchy.
